title: IATF ƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒe
summary: International Accessibility Task Force ƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒe.
problem: IATF hiã dukɔmevi ƒe aƒe si anɔ anyi ɖaa si aɖe kpɔɖeŋua me, ayɔ dɔ vovovoawo ŋkɔ, eye wòahe amesiwo le asi kpem ɖe dɔa ŋu la ƒe susu ayi afɔɖeɖe si sɔ la dzi.
why: Afisia nye IATF ƒe ʋɔtru si le ʋuʋu na ame sia ame. Wowɔe be wòanye dɔwɔƒe sue aɖe ale be wòanɔ bɔbɔe be woaxlẽe, aɖe egɔme ahalé be nɛ le gota.
scopeIn: Dukɔwo ƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒe siwo ɖe IATF ƒe ɖoɖowo me
IATF ƒe dɔwɔɖoɖo siwo dzi woda asi ɖo, esiwo le dɔ wɔm, kple esiwo le nudzraɖoƒe siwo me nyatakakawo le, wo dzi kpɔlawo, nu siwo woadzra ɖo, kple numedzodzrowo le
Biabiawo xɔxɔ ƒe axa kple nɔnɔmetata
Eŋlisigbe me ŋɔŋlɔdzesi si ŋu wotrɔ asi le xoxo
Static deployment le Cloudflare Workers Static Assets dzi
scopeOut: Private member areas, accounts, alo login flows
Dɔwɔɖua ƒe dzɔdzɔmegbalẽ, si nɔa dɔwɔƒe ɖe sia ɖe ŋutɔ ƒe nudzraɖoƒe
Real-time dzeɖoɖo, si nɔa Discord me
Numetoto le dɔdeasi ɖe sia ɖe ŋu, si nɔa dɔdeasia ƒe GitHub nudzraɖoƒe

title: IATF selfie

problem: Ŋgɔdonya le dɔwɔnu aɖe si ŋu wotrɔ asi le be wòakpe ɖe amewo ŋu la ŋu le IATF ƒe kpɔkplɔ te.
why: Wowɔa agbalẽdzraɖoƒea ŋuti nyatakakawo ɖe ame sia ame si, togbɔ be wodzudzɔ dɔa wɔwɔ hã.
scopeIn: Mɔ̃ aɖe si ŋu wotrɔ asi le be wòakpe ɖe amewo ŋu la ƒe kpɔɖeŋu gbãtɔ
